name: protolint-explainable-auto-disable-audit-trail
instr:
Make automatic disable operations explainable through a structured audit trail that identifies each attempt, its chosen placement, its finalized coordinates, and whether it was written. Expose identical deterministic evidence through command, embedded library, and MCP linting while preserving behavior for callers that do not request auditing.

Each discovered failure produces one stable, distinct audit attempt in discovery order, including repeated locations, carrying its rule, original span, actual disposition, result span, and final status. Finalized result spans identify the directive bytes actually inserted or merged after all queued edits shift the source. Noop records an ordered `AuditSkipped` attempt without opening, changing, or writing the target. Strategy creation and finalization failures return all available evidence, never marking unwritten edits as written or fabricating successful attempts. Audit documents order files by input and attempts by discovery, and encode byte-identically for equivalent command, library, and MCP executions. Command audit persistence failures and MCP finalization failures retain available evidence but use their established internal-failure classification; ordinary lint failures retain diagnostics and lint-failure classification. Existing `Lint`, unaudited MCP responses, fix messages, error interpretation, writers, and placement side effects remain unchanged. `SourceSpan` has `Start int` and `End int`; `AuditSummary` has `File string` an
